What is rapid intensification?

Here it means wind increasing by at least 30 knots in the next 24 hours, using one consistent three-minute wind convention. A knot is about 1.85 km/h.

Infrared sees temperature patterns in clouds. The water-vapour channel provides a different view of the atmosphere. These artificial pictures only test whether the software works.

What must happen before real use?
  1. Download authorised INSAT data from MOSDAC.
  2. Check channel units, coordinates, dates and arrival times.
  3. Train with complete past image sequences and matching IMD wind labels.
  4. Evaluate once on untouched real storms; compare simpler methods.
  5. Have meteorologists review failures and run a monitored trial.

No real INSAT images or trained CNN–GRU weights are included in this demo.
